title: Türkiye Denies Claim It Will Send 15,000 Troops to Somalia
excerpt: Türkiye's Ministry of National Defence said claims that Ankara will deploy 15,000 troops to Somalia do not reflect the truth.
rank_math_title: Türkiye denies 15,000 troops for Somalia claim | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: Türkiye's defence ministry denied claims that 15,000 troops will be sent to Somalia, saying its task force and air component continue training and advisory work.
